Pros

   Intuitive user interface and ease of navigation 
   Extensive customization capabilities with plugins and extensions 
   Comprehensive built-in developer tools for web inspection and debugging 
   Strong emphasis on security and privacy protection 
   Enhances operational efficiency and productivity for various tasks 

Cons

   Occasional browser instability, including unexpected crashes 
   Limited integration with some external services and enterprise authentication 
   Desire for broader extension compatibility and more robust built-in ad blocking 
   Concerns regarding the initial user interface setup experience
